READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS FIRST

of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
The number of marks is given in brackets [ ] at the end of each question or part question.

This document consists of 3 printed pages, 1 blank page and 1 insert.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–1918
1 How important to the failure of the Schlieffen Plan was Belgium’s reaction to invasion? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant was the Battle of the Somme to Britain? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–1945
How important were reparations as a cause of the problems of the Weimar government between
1919 and 1924? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was the war of 1939–45 in changing life in Nazi Germany? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–1941
How important was the 1905 Revolution to the eventual overthrow of Tsarism in Russia? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant in causing its downfall was the Provisional Government’s decision to continue
Russia’s participation in the First World War? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY D: THE USA, 1919–1941
How significant was the entertainment industry in changing life in America in the ‘Roaring
Twenties’? Explain your answer. [40]
How important were Republican reactions to the Wall Street Crash as causes of Roosevelt’s
success in the presidential election of 1932? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important was the invasion of China by the Japanese for the rivalry between the Nationalist
government and the Communists? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was the Cultural Revolution? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA c.1940–c.1994
How significant was the Defiance Campaign of 1952 in the development of opposition to apartheid
by 1966? Explain your answer. [40]
How important were President Botha’s policies in ending apartheid? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was the division between Israel’s enemies in determining the outcome of the Six
Day War, 1967? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was superpower involvement in Arab-Israeli conflicts between 1956 and 1973?
Explain your answer. [40]
